historical_native_failures_reproduced: forward edge absent before requires_grad enable
formal_native_qualification.count_policy: Do not sum repeated replays or separate suites into unique upstream API coverage.

optimizer.numeric_policy: Exact unsigned binary32 words, including signed zero; exact parameter/state Versions and gradient presence. No floating tolerance.
optimizer.identity_policy: Reference opaque identity relationships map to observed native stable Tensor incarnations or live public tokens and typed Storage IDs; host addresses are never compared.
optimizer.observer_policy: State inspection closes only a transiently published state token. It does not retain an extra public state root beyond a snapshot.

private-roots.scope: One ownership/migration/admission control with fixed dyadic expected words, separate from the actual hosted 24/6 replay.

accumulator-lifetime.observer_contract: Read-only inspection of this test child committed owner; no new private/public Storage reference is created by reading grad Hold identity, bits or allocation lifetime.

observer-adaptation.scope: executable identity, internal state tags, and read-only eight-kind data offsets

signedzero.comparison: Unsigned binary32 word equality; +0 and -0 remain different; no tolerance.

partial.gradient_presence_comparison: Strict command59 == (actual Torch grad is not None), before and after every call; no zero-for-None substitution.
partial.schedule_comparison: Native successful-node count, successful-leaf count, first failing opcode, runtime error class and partial gradient state are checked against actual Torch tracing. Native per-node hook events are not exposed and are not claimed measured.
partial.reference_execution: The fixed report already ran on pinned Torch with tracing/untraced controls; this command executes only native HIA.

grad-clear.scope: True/False nullable-gradient semantics, strict None/present state, signed-zero reconstruction, partial/retained backward and skip invariance. Explicit legacy optimizer state, missing native step Tensor and public grad-object identity remain open.

release_source_equivalence.change: The release commit adds five lines under [tool.ruff], setting target-version to py310 with explanatory comments. There are no deletions. Every other root entry and every source subtree is identical.
release_source_equivalence.scope: Only this exact official wheel SHA256/build commit and this exact inventory release commit. This is source equivalence for the recorded lint-only release change, not identity of the two Git commits or an allowance for other builds.

live_joint32.scope: Rank zero through four CPU binary32 Tensor fill, owned Generator state, bounded backward 57/58 and plain SGD trajectories. Full API, tracked nonleaf uniform autograd and optimizer-object lifecycle remain open.
